_comment: Pixel 6 baseline Metronome run. Identical to monkey_espresso_mirror_2min_baseline.json EXCEPT the device block points to Pixel 6 instead of Pixel 3. Pixel 6 is arm64-v8a only — the Bangcle Metronome APK (armeabi-v7a only) WILL NOT install here, so this config only references the multi-arch baseline APK. If the BatteryManager companion fails with SecurityException on Pixel 6, run: adb -s <PIXEL6_SERIAL> shell pm grant com.example.batterymanager_utility android.permission.BATTERY_STATS
